decision_conditions: The external finishing materials shall match those used in the construction of the existing building and/or areas of hard surfacing. Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance.

The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice.Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans as set out in the attached schedule which forms part of this notice.1774_3041774_305_A1774_3111774_3311774_330_B1774_303Energy AssessmentSuDS Pro formaSustainable Drainage Assessment SAP CalculationsPlanning StatementHighway Safety Impact Assessment  Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning

Prior to first occupation of the development hereby permitted, details of the design of refuse storag e facilities including facilities for the recycling of waste to satisfy the future number of occupiers on site, shall be provided within the development, in accordance with the London Borough of Enfield - Waste and Recycling Planning Storage Guidance ENV 08/162.In particular, waste collection vehicles must be able to get within 25m of the refuse storage point. Residents should not have to carry waste further than 30m.Reason: In order to facilitate efficient, safe and clean removal of household refuse, the location and accessibility of refuse storage plus to maintain safety on the Highway.

Prior to first occupation of the development hereby permitted, unless otherwise submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, cycle parking must be provided in compliance with the following criteria: o	Provision of a minimum of FOUR long stay cycle parking spaces (two per unit)o	in an accessible location within the front garden: the access route to the store should be a minimum of 1.2m wide to enable the bike to enter the store, should be step free and involve no more than 2 doors or gates (excluding the store door) which must also have a minimum opening width of 1.2mo	secured: with a British Standard mortice lock or access fobo	fully enclosed: 4 walls and a roofReason: The Council's Climate Action and Transport Policies seek to increase the use of active and sustainable transport modes. This means that access to bicycle parking should be easy and secure to remove potential barriers to cycling.

The development shall be carried out in accordance with the submitted Energy Statement prepared by energytest dated 28/01/2026. All approved energy efficiency and low-carbon measures shall be installed before first occupation and retained thereafter for the lifetime of the development.Reason: In the interest of sustainable development and to ensure that the Local Planning Authority may be satisfied that CO2 emission reduction targets are met in accordance with Policy CP20 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), Policies DMD49, DMD50 and DMD51 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).

Prior first occupation of the development hereby approved, the applicant shall submit to and obtain written approval from the Local Planning Authority a Final Energy Statement (or SAP/SBEM compliance report) demonstrating that the development has achieved a minimum 35% reduction in CO"² emissions beyond the requirements of Building Regulations Part L 2021. The approved energy efficiency and low carbon measures shall be fully installed prior to first occupation and shall be retained permanently.Reason: In the interest of sustainable development and to ensure that the Local Planning Authority may be satisfied that CO"² emission reduction targets are met, in accordance with Policy CP20 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010) and Policies DMD49, DMD50 and DMD51 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014)

The development must achieve reduced water consumption through the use of water efficient fittings, appliances and recycling systems to result in consumption equal to or less than 105 litres per person per day.Reason: To promote water conservation and efficiency measures in all new developments and where possible in the retrofitting of existing stock in accordance with Core Policy 21 of the Core Strategy and the London Plan.
